correctness.rationale: The complete-graph measurement chain has exactly balanced inverse moves: insertion/deletion ratio z=(1-p)/(p(n-1)), symmetric endpoint-slide and reconnection moves, and irreducibility. Matching enumeration yields the full cut-crossing generating function by choosing j crossing endpoints and arbitrary residual internal matchings. Differentiation gives exact first two moments. Exact monomer-count mass ratios and a strictly concave Stirling profile at theta*u^2=1-u yield Var(m)/n -> 2u(1-u)/(2-u); conditional first two crossing moments and total variance give the stated coefficient. Rational state-by-state transition and generating-function verification for every n=2..8 and 3 rational p corroborates the symbolic argument; numeric 4000-site checks corroborate but do not prove asymptotics.

value.rationale: The source motivates entanglement growth and phase scaling in a Bell-measurement-only circuit but leaves precise trajectory fluctuation statistics open. The complete finite-size distribution and explicit asymptotic entropy variance are natural directly measurable observables and separate local matching randomness from global density fluctuations. This is not a parameter tweak or routine finite census: the exact stationary reversible measure and a nontrivial monomer saddle are used to extract a new extensive-fluctuation law; it supplies error bars for measurements and analytic finite-size benchmarks. No downstream quantum speedup or unproved performance claim is needed.
